title: Samsung Just Gave Last Year's Watch 6 NEW Health Features 😳
description:
Last year's Galaxy Watch just got this year's health features. 😳

Samsung's One UI 9 Watch update brings six health and fitness features from the Galaxy Watch9 and Watch Ultra2 to the Galaxy Watch8 and Watch8 Classic: Heart Health Score, Vitals (five overnight readings), Daily Cardio Load, Fitness Index, upgraded Sleep Coaching and an upgraded sleep apnea feature. Sleep Coaching goes back as far as the Galaxy Watch4.

The catch: Samsung says availability varies by country and model, and some features need separate Samsung Health or Health Monitor app updates. This Black Friday week the Watch8 (40 mm) is from $199.99 in the US ($299.99 regular); the Galaxy Watch9 starts at $379.99.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 71/100 → SPEC. Grab it if you want new health tricks without Watch9 money.
